title: The Lion and the Shepherd
summary: A shepherd pulled a painful thorn from a limping lion's paw. Years later, captured and cast into the arena to be devoured, the lion recognized his healer, licked his hands, and def...
full_text: A shepherd pulled a painful thorn from a limping lion's paw. Years later, captured and cast into the arena to be devoured, the lion recognized his healer, licked his hands, and defended him before the assembly.
moral: Kindness shown to a wild beast is remembered in the hour of peril.
